description: Shared portal-based overlay primitives in src/components/ui/overlay/ plus the --z-layer-* tokens. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-003 (no data-model dependency) but must precede the UI FEATs. Root-cause fix for clipped menus / mispositioned fixed modals / z-index inflation / window.confirm; no z-index bumps, no new npm dependency, no migration of other screens (ThemedModal and legacy src/components/Tooltip.tsx untouched). Review findings addressed here: MEDIUM 2 (stacked modal surfaces: single active focus trap, inert on non-top surfaces, opener-captured focus restore, ref-counted scroll lock) and carried-over: consistent --z-layer-* tokens, collision-aware positioning, ConfirmDialog replacing window.confirm.
steps: Read context.json, design.md sections 8.1-8.7 and design-review.md finding 2; read src/components/ThemedModal.tsx, src/components/Tooltip.tsx, src/components/ui/Button.tsx, IconButton.tsx, classNames.ts, and src/index.css lines ~85-100 for conventions.

src/index.css: ADD (do not redefine or alias existing --z-sidebar/--z-topbar/--z-drawer/--z-modal) the tokens --z-layer-base:0, -raised:10, -sticky-nav:30, -dropdown:1000, -popover:1050, -tooltip:1100, -drawer-backdrop:1200, -drawer:1210, -dialog-backdrop:1300, -dialog:1310, -critical:1400 in :root. Also add a small `.qr-overlay-root` rule if needed (no transform/filter anywhere on the host).

src/components/ui/overlay/computePosition.ts: pure computePosition(anchorRect, floatingSize, viewport, {placement, offset, padding=8}) -> {x,y,placement,maxHeight} with flip, cross-axis shift, clamp and maxHeight scroll; placements bottom/top/left/right with -start/-end. src/components/ui/overlay/useFloatingPosition.ts: useLayoutEffect measure on open, window resize, scroll with capture:true throttled via requestAnimationFrame, ResizeObserver on anchor and floating, close/hide when anchor leaves the viewport or !isConnected; uses getBoundingClientRect and visualViewport/documentElement.clientWidth so browser zoom needs no special case.

src/components/ui/overlay/overlayHost.ts: getOverlayHost() lazily creates and returns `<div id="qr-overlay-root">` appended to document.body (idempotent, works in tests). src/components/ui/overlay/LayerContext.tsx: Dialog/Drawer render a layer-host element as a SIBLING after the panel inside the same portal container (panel z-index 0, layer host z-index 1); Menu/Select/Popover/Tooltip opened inside a surface portal into that host, otherwise into #qr-overlay-root with the numeric tokens. Dialog panel animation uses opacity only (no transform).

src/components/ui/overlay/overlayStack.ts (MEDIUM 2, single owner of trapping): entries {id, kind:'dialog'|'drawer'|'menu'|'popover'|'tooltip', modal:boolean, container:HTMLElement, opener:Element|null (captured at register/open time = document.activeElement then), onRequestClose}. Rules: (a) Escape closes only the top-most entry; (b) outside pointerdown closes only when outside the top-most layer and its anchor; (c) ONLY the top-most MODAL entry (Dialog or modal Drawer) has an active focus trap (Tab/Shift+Tab cycle inside it; non-modal menus/popovers inside it are part of its trap scope); (d) every non-top modal entry gets the `inert` attribute on its portal container, removed when it becomes top again; #root gets inert/aria-hidden while any modal entry is open; (e) on close: pop entry, un-inert the new top modal first, THEN restore focus to the entry's captured opener (even if that opener lives inside another surface) if still connected, else body; (f) scroll lock on body is ref-counted (overflow hidden + scrollbar-width padding compensation), only the last release restores the original body styles. Export a hook useOverlayEntry(...) used by Dialog/Drawer/Menu/Popover/Select/Tooltip.

Primitives, each with tests: Dialog.tsx (props open,onClose,title,description,size,footer,role 'dialog'|'alertdialog',dismissible,closeOnBackdrop; portal; backdrop --z-layer-dialog-backdrop, panel --z-layer-dialog; flex column max-height calc(100dvh - 32px), header fixed, body overflow-y-auto min-h-0 flex-1, footer shrink-0 always visible; aria-modal, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby; initial focus on [data-autofocus] else first focusable else panel tabIndex -1; Escape closes if dismissible and top-most; alertdialog: closeOnBackdrop false and Escape == Cancel; backdrop closes only when both mousedown and click targets are the backdrop; prefers-reduced-motion respected). ConfirmDialog.tsx + useConfirm() -> confirm({title,message,confirmLabel,tone:'danger'}) => Promise<boolean>, Cancel is data-autofocus, resolves false on Cancel/Escape/unmount. Menu.tsx (trigger aria-haspopup/aria-expanded, role=menu/menuitem/menuitemcheckbox, roving focus Arrow/Home/End/typeahead, Enter/Space activate+close, Escape closes and refocuses trigger, outside pointerdown closes without swallowing the click, Tab closes, maxHeight scroll). Popover.tsx (non-modal arbitrary content). Select.tsx (button + listbox, aria-activedescendant, keyboard nav, min width = trigger width, `placeholder` prop shown when value is not among options - needed by FEAT-004 NIT 6). Tooltip.tsx (new, distinct from src/components/Tooltip.tsx: hover delay 400 ms and focus, hides on blur/Escape/pointerleave/scroll, role=tooltip + aria-describedby, pointer-events none, max-width 240, clamped via computePosition, timers cleared on unmount, disabled-trigger wrapper span tabIndex 0). Drawer.tsx (side right, modal prop, width min(360px,100vw), backdrop --z-layer-drawer-backdrop, panel --z-layer-drawer, internal scroll, same focus management as Dialog via the stack). Export all from src/components/ui/index.ts barrel (additive only).

Tests (Vitest/jsdom, mock getBoundingClientRect/ResizeObserver): computePosition table tests (flip bottom->top, shift left/right, clamp, maxHeight when taller than viewport, the five viewport sizes 1920x1080,1536x864,1366x768,1280x720,1024x768); overlayStack Escape closes only top; index.css token-order test parsing src/index.css and asserting ordering of the NEW --z-layer-* tokens only (base < sticky-nav < dropdown < popover < tooltip < drawer-backdrop < drawer < dialog-backdrop < dialog < critical) and that existing --z-sidebar/--z-topbar/--z-drawer/--z-modal values are unchanged; Dialog (focus trap cycle, focus restore, Escape, alertdialog backdrop does not close, long body scrolls while footer remains in DOM, scroll lock released on unmount); ConfirmDialog resolves false on Escape and Cancel is focused; Menu (arrows, Escape returns focus, outside click closes, item click closes); Tooltip (fake timers, no state update after unmount); Select (keyboard, placeholder when value not in options). MEDIUM 2 stacked-surface tests in src/components/ui/overlay/stackedModals.test.tsx: open a modal Drawer from an opener button, then a Dialog from a button inside the Drawer -> (1) Tab/Shift+Tab cycle only inside the Dialog; (2) the Drawer container has the inert attribute while the Dialog is open and not after it closes; (3) Escape closes only the Dialog, Drawer stays open; (4) after the Dialog closes focus returns to the button inside the Drawer that opened it; (5) document.body scroll lock is still applied after the Dialog closes and is released (original body overflow/padding restored) only after the Drawer also closes; also the reverse close order and Escape twice closes both in order.
Run verification; commit `feat(ui): portal overlay primitives with stacked-modal focus management` staging only the specific files.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run src/components/ui` passes including stackedModals.test.tsx covering all five MEDIUM 2 assertions
Existing --z-sidebar/--z-topbar/--z-drawer/--z-modal values in src/index.css are unchanged; only additive --z-layer-* tokens added
No file outside src/components/ui/overlay, src/components/ui/index.ts and src/index.css is modified; ThemedModal.tsx and src/components/Tooltip.tsx are untouched

findings:
Commit 1341c02 'feat(ui): portal overlay primitives with stacked-modal focus management'. Only touched src/components/ui/overlay/*, src/components/ui/index.ts (additive), src/index.css (additive --z-layer-* tokens + .qr-overlay-fade). ThemedModal/Tooltip untouched. Verified: npx vitest run src/components/ui (9 files, 62 tests pass incl. stackedModals.test.tsx), npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, git diff --stat main on ThemedModal/Tooltip empty. Full `npx vitest run` has 2 UNRELATED failures in src/components/ControlPanel/ControlPanel.test.tsx (renderer selector; came with the separate scrcpy 5.0.1 commit e00d802), not touched here.
EXPORTS (all from src/components/ui/index.ts):
- Dialog {open,onClose,title:string,description?:ReactNode,size?:'sm'|'md'|'lg'|'xl'(420/560/760/960px),footer?,role?:'dialog'|'alertdialog',dismissible?=true,closeOnBackdrop?=true (forced false for alertdialog),className?,children}. Description renders at top of the scrolling body. Dialog has a built-in header close IconButton (hidden for alertdialog / non-dismissible). Initial focus: [data-autofocus] else first focusable else panel.
- ConfirmDialog (controlled: open,title,message,confirmLabel,cancelLabel,tone:'danger'|'default',onConfirm,onCancel) and useConfirm() -> {confirm(opts)=>Promise<boolean>, confirmDialog:ReactNode}; render {confirmDialog} once in the tree. Resolves false on Cancel/Escape/new confirm()/unmount. Cancel has data-autofocus.
- Drawer {open,onClose,title,side?:'right'|'left',modal?=true,footer?,className?,children}; width min(360px,100vw); has header close button.
- Menu {items:MenuItem[],trigger:ReactNode (button content),triggerLabel:string (aria-label),triggerClassName?,placement?,disabled?}; MenuItem {id,label,textValue?,icon?,onSelect,disabled?,checked? (defined => menuitemcheckbox),danger?,separatorBefore?}. Menu renders its own trigger <button>. On activation it focuses the trigger, closes, then calls onSelect (so a Dialog opened from onSelect captures the trigger as opener).
- Popover {trigger,triggerLabel,triggerClassName?,contentClassName?,placement?,disabled?,onOpenChange?,children: ReactNode | ({close})=>ReactNode}; content role=dialog aria-label=triggerLabel; focuses [data-autofocus]/first focusable on open; Tab off either end closes and refocuses trigger.
- Select {value,options:{value,label,disabled?}[],onChange,disabled?,placeholder?='Select…' (shown when value not in options),'aria-label'?,id?,className? (trigger),placement?}; focus moves to the listbox (aria-activedescendant); min-width = trigger width; onChange only fires when value differs.
- Tooltip {content,children:ReactElement (single element),placement?='top',delay?=400}; wraps child in <span class=inline-flex>; disabled child => span tabIndex=0 + aria-describedby.
- Also exported: computePosition, Placement type, getOverlayHost, useFloatingPosition, useOverlayEntry. Extra internals in overlay/: Surface.tsx (shared Dialog/Drawer shell), LayerContext.tsx (useLayerHost), overlayStack.ts (registerOverlay, getFocusable, getOverlayStack, consumePointerClose), overlayUtils.ts, testUtils.ts (mockLayout(): gives every element a 100x30 box at 100,100 and stubs ResizeObserver; returns restore fn).
BEHAVIOUR LATER STEPS MUST KNOW:
- In jsdom, tests that open Menu/Select/Popover/Tooltip need no layout mocks IF the anchor rect is all-zero: useFloatingPosition treats an all-zero box as 'no layout info' and does NOT close the overlay as scrolled-out. Real boxes outside the viewport do close it. Importing ../ui/overlay/testUtils mockLayout() is optional but gives realistic positions.
- Portal content stops React click/mousedown/keydown bubbling at the overlay (Surface container, Menu/Select/Popover lists) so a menu click does not trigger an ancestor card onClick.
- Overlays render in body > #qr-overlay-root; while any modal is open #root gets inert + aria-hidden, body overflow hidden (ref-counted, scrollbar padding compensated). Non-top modal surfaces get inert on their [data-overlay-surface] container.
- Z-index: Dialog/Drawer container uses the *-backdrop token, panel the dialog/drawer token, layer host calc(panelToken + 1); menu/select use var(--z-layer-dropdown), popover --z-layer-popover, tooltip --z-layer-tooltip (inside a surface they portal into its layer host).
- Backdrop dismiss needs mousedown AND click on backdrop; a pointerdown that closed a menu/popover is consumed so it does not also close the Dialog.
- Escape: closes only the top-most stack entry (tooltips included, so a visible tooltip eats the first Escape). Safari/WKWebView fallback: opener is derived from the last pointer target (<1s) when activeElement is body.
- Reverse-order close (lower surface closes while upper stays) skips focus restore so the upper surface keeps focus.
- No eslint config in repo; none was run.
- Not implemented (not asked): exit animations (surfaces unmount immediately), nested submenus, Menu labelledBy prop is the triggerLabel string.
